description: This file defines the BodyParsingMiddleware class in the Slim Framework, responsible for parsing HTTP request bodies in various formats such as JSON, XML, and form-urlencoded data. It implements middleware functionality to process requests and attach parsed content.

classes.name: BodyParsingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that registers and processes various body parsers for HTTP requests, handling JSON, XML, and form data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware and registers default body parsers, allowing optional custom parsers.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes an incoming request, parsing its body if not already parsed, and passes it to the handler.

methods.name: registerBodyParser
methods.description: Registers a custom parser for a specific media type.

methods.name: hasBodyParser
methods.description: Checks if a parser for the given media type exists.

methods.name: getBodyParser
methods.description: Retrieves the parser associated with a media type, throws if none exists.

methods.name: registerDefaultBodyParsers
methods.description: Registers default parsers for application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, and XML media types.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Attempts to parse the request body based on its media type.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the media type from the request's Content-Type header.

methods.name: disableXmlEntityLoader
methods.description: Disables XML entity loader functionality based on libxml version.
